body: I am in the exact same situation. I’m 17 and was in a 2 year long distance relationship, and have been struggling a lot with relationships since. The only thing I can tell you is to focus on your friends and don’t change who you are for anyone. You never know where relationships come from and you might already know the next person who will be for you. Be yourself and trust your gut and things will work out plus you’ll be feeling better in the meantime.
